summary.title: Add commit-side session review and atomic corrections
summary.text: From a commit page, readers can compare every eligible session with its comparison evidence, and repository writers can confirm or reject the loaded sessions in one atomic save. Unseen pairs, other commits and cross-repository links are untouched. Two migrations add retry receipts and a shared evidence fingerprint, and every writer of comparison evidence now takes the same repository lock.

review_exchange.summary: All three agent reviews assess earlier heads. Two Codex rounds identified should-fix risks in stale-evidence hashing and concurrent snapshot updates, with follow-up commits recorded for both; the first finding is resolved and the second remains open. Cursor's stale approval raised three dismissed considerations about repository-wide locking, non-default-branch evidence and opt-in real-data coverage. Two human diff replies are indexed, but their bodies were unavailable in the generation input, so their substance cannot be summarized.

blocks.text: Let a commit page compare every eligible session with the same admission rules the resolver uses, so a reviewer sees the evidence behind linked, suggested and rejected sessions.

steps.text: Candidates are the union of matched edges, manual rejections and sessions admitted by the resolver prefilter for the commit's primary repository, ordered linked first, then suggested, then rejected, then by time proximity to the commit
Pages are keyset-based with a limit of 1 to the analytics maximum; a malformed or foreign cursor is rejected as invalid

An unauthorized or unknown commit returns not found; the response states whether the caller can write, and lists attribution from other repositories separately as non-editable
The analytics repository receives the resolver's matcher configuration so candidate admission follows the configured prefilter and tolerance

blocks.text: Let a repository writer confirm or reject the loaded sessions for one commit atomically, without touching unseen pairs, other commits or cross-repository links, which the existing per-session editor cannot do safely.

steps.text: Write authorization failures and unknown commits return not found; a request without a request id, with duplicate sessions or with a missing snapshot is rejected as invalid

The save takes the repository linkage advisory lock, verifies the commit exists, and validates every reviewed snapshot in one statement before writing; any mismatch returns a conflict and writes nothing
Selected pairs become manual matches and unselected loaded pairs become manually unlinked edges; a selection also clears the commit's automatic outcome so resolution does not re-link it
A receipt keyed by request id stores the digest of the reviewed set; an identical retry commits without changes and a different payload under the same id is rejected
Migration 000028 adds the receipt table with a composite key and cascade from the commit; the down migration drops it

items.text: Idempotency comes from a stored request digest rather than comparing current edges, so a retried save after an intervening reversal cannot reapply the old decision
